season.evidence: Web: Mountaineers lists the Chikamin route June-October; other pages say mid-summer to early fall once snow is minimal; peak logs peak Aug (100) and Sep (81). Stored Jul-Sep kept; Oct allowed as the one-month margin.

track.why: Catalog holds exactly one route here (PCT start). Round trip from PCT North Trailhead (start/end 157 m from our pin), summited, logged Commonwealth Basin Trail -> PCT -> Boot Trail, about 27 mi and 8,750 ft; the line follows the PCT north and leaves it at our gully-turnoff waypoint (17 m away) before the summit. 1 Oct 2020 is within a month of Sep. Note: the line is thin (42 points).

notes: The catalog lacks the Glacier Lake (Mineral Creek, Park Lakes) route, which most logged ascents use (about 15.5-16.6 mi round trip, 5,700-6,200 ft gain, Jul-Sep). Worth adding as its own route; no facts written for it since it is not stored.
